issues.explanation: The printed term heading in INSO 23683 at clause 3.1.34 is «داده‌شارها» (evidence T23683-3.1.34: «داده‌شارها | streaming data»), not «داده‌شار». The heading in INSO 23681 Annex الف‑۲ is likewise «داده‌شارها» (evidence O23681-084). The section implies a difference in morphological form between the two standards (singular vs. plural) that does not exist in the evidence; both standards print the plural form «داده‌شارها». The actual distinction is semantic/contextual, not a difference in the term's printed form.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace «داده‌شار» در ۲۳۶۸۳ with «داده‌شارها» (the printed term at 3.1.34) so the sentence reads: «داده‌شارها» در ۲۳۶۸۳ (بند ۳.۱.۳۴) و «داده‌شارها» در پیوست الف‑۲ استاندارد ۲۳۶۸۱. Add a brief note that the form of the term is identical in both standards; only the meaning and context differ (streaming data vs. training data-flow label).
